title: fynkel.Follow
description: Keeps the entity at a named entity's world position plus `offset`, after the tick's physics, optionally turned to look at it. With `smoothing` 0 it snaps; otherwise it closes the gap at that rate per second (`1 − e^(−smoothing·dt)` of the distance per tick), the usual exponential follow. The target is named (`fynkel.Name`, the first match in entity order); an empty or unknown name leaves the entity where it is. A camera follows with `ThirdPersonCamera` instead.

target.description: The followed entity's name; empty follows nothing.

offset.description: Metres from the target's world position, world axes.

look_at.description: Also turn the entity's -Z towards the target's position.
